title: Magnetic Field
content: The magnetic field is a region where magnetic effects can be detected[cite: 1].

title: Magnetisation
content: A process of making a magnetic material into a magnet is called magnetisation[cite: 1].

title: Induced Magnetism
content: Induced magnetism occurs when a piece of unmagnetised magnetic material is brought near to the pole of a permanent magnet, causing it to be attracted and become a magnet itself[cite: 1].

title: Hard Magnetic Materials
content: Magnetic materials such as steel which are harder to magnetise but retain their magnetism longer are called hard magnetic materials[cite: 1].

title: Soft Magnetic Materials
content: Magnetic materials such as iron or special alloys like mumetal alloy which are easier to magnetise but do not retain their magnetism very long are called soft magnetic materials[cite: 1].
